purpose: S11 adds decline durability (D7) to the invitations module: the sponsor persists inviteeRef -> pubkey in the pending-direct-invite marker at invite time; welcomeDeclined durably marks it declined before any removal work; the removal runs outside the listener (client job queue), through the GroupOpQueue after a bounded synced(), is retried for every declined marker at startup, and only after removeMember resolved the marker is cleared and one declined announcement is sent as an MLS group message.

public_api.name: createDeclineDurability
public_api.signature: (deps: { store: DeclineMarkerStore; getGroup: (groupId) => Promise<DeclineGroup | undefined>; queue: Pick<GroupOpQueue,'runCommit'>; announce: (group, content) => Promise<unknown>; enqueue: ClientJobQueue['enqueue']; onError?; syncTimeoutMs?; retryDelaysMs?: readonly number[]; maxAgeMs?: number; now?: () => number }) => DeclineDurability
public_api.description: Every port validated at construction. { onWelcomeDeclined(payload), startupRetry(), retryDeclined(): Promise<DeclineOutcome[]>, replayMarker(groupId, pubkey), idle(), dispose() }. onWelcomeDeclined is the client-event listener: synchronous, no client call, starts the durable declined write at once and enqueues the removal as its last action. DeclineOutcome: removed | already-removed | superseded | no-marker | group-missing | retry-later | terminal | expired. A terminal removal rejection (isTerminalRemovalError: not-a-member, invalid-options/not-admin, group disbanded/abandoned) compare-and-clears the marker, is reported once and is never retried; a declined marker older than DECLINED_MARKER_MAX_AGE_MS (30 days) is dropped on replay (expired). In-session backoff (DEFAULT_RETRY_DELAYS_MS 30 s, 2 min, 10 min) follows retry-later / group-missing.

public_api.name: createMarkerRecordingInviter
public_api.signature: (deps: { inviter: Pick<KeyPackageInviter,'inviteByPubkey'>; store: Pick<DeclineMarkerStore,'record'>; onRecordedDeclined: (groupId, pubkey) => void; onError?; now?: () => number }) => Pick<KeyPackageInviter,'inviteByPubkey'>
public_api.description: Persists inviteeRef -> pubkey (declined:false, plus leafKey when exactly one leaf was added) after an accepted invite, best-effort (a failing write is reported, the invite result is returned unchanged). invitedAt = now() is read BEFORE the invite runs and passed to record(): an orphan decline older than it is stale and not adopted. onRecordedDeclined is REQUIRED (validated at construction): called when the record adopted an orphan decline; wire it to DeclineDurability.replayMarker.

public_api.name: buildDeclinedAnnouncementContent
public_api.description: {type:'invite_lifecycle',event:'declined',pubkey,id:dedupId}: the parseStructured shape plus the stable dedup id (declinedDedupId(groupId, inviteeRef)); no profile data.

public_api.name: PendingDirectInviteMarker (pendingDirectInviteStorage.ts)
public_api.signature: { inviteeRef: string; pubkey: string; declined: boolean; leafKey?: string; phase?: 'declined' | 'removing' | 'announce-pending'; declinedAt?: number }
public_api.description: Seam consumed by S14 (cancel invitation) and S17 (wipe). recordPendingDirectInvite(groupId,pubkey,inviteeRef,leafKey?,invitedAt?) (an orphan decline is adopted only when orphan.receivedAt >= invitedAt; absent invitedAt adopts any live orphan), getPendingDirectInviteMarker, markPendingDirectInviteDeclined(groupId,inviteeRef) (stamps declinedAt), setPendingDirectInvitePhase, clearPendingDirectInviteIfRef, loadDeclinedPendingDirectInvites(onInvalid?), pendingDirectInviteMarkerStore; legacy (bare true / no inviteeRef) values and records whose phase is outside PHASES are invalid: ignored without throwing (an invalid phase is reported through onInvalid), never coerced; existing clear/consume/bulk-clear exports unchanged.
